BrochureContent.Content:
John Coyne Estates are delighted to bring to the market this wonderfully spacious 4-Bed home located in the popular Cluain Craoibh development. This stunning home comes to the market in immaculate condition and ready to walk into. The ground floor accommodation briefly comprises of a large hallway with guest w/c underneath the staircase, kitchen-dining room with patio doors to the stunning rear garden, utility room and living room with open fire. The first floor consists of 4 bedrooms (master en-suite) and family bathroom.

This magnificent home is ideally located within walking distance to all amenities and early viewing is highly recommended.

Entrance Hallway: large entrance hallway with attractive floor tiles, radiator cover and carpeted staircase.

Kitchen-Dining Room: with white kitchen units at both eye and floor level, integrated appliances and an abundance of natural lighting. The open-plan dining area boats attractive tiling and patio doors to the stunning rear garden.

Utility Room: with fitted units and external door.

Living Room: with beautiful fireplace, solid fuel stove, semi solid flooring and bay window.

Guest W/C: with w/c and whb. (Under staircase)

Landing with new high quality laminate flooring.

Master Bedroom: large double bedroom with solid pine flooring, built-in wardrobes and en-suite.
En-Suite: with w/c, whb and electric shower.

Bedroom 2: large double bedroom with built in wardrobes.

Bedroom 3: double bedroom with rear aspect.

Bedroom 4: single bedroom with front facing aspect.

Bathroom: beautifully tiled throughout. W/c, whb and bath.

Outside: absolutely stunning rear garden which has been expertly designed and easy to maintain.

- Fully alarmed.
- Oil fired central heating.
- Neutral colour scheme throughout.
- Blinds throughout.
- Close to all amenities.
- Block wall construction.
- Spacious 4 bed house.
- Immaculate condition throughout.
- Minutes from M4/M6 motorways.
- PVC double glazed windows
- Breathtaking rear garden.
